headline: CBA Reports Record Third Quarter Profit of 616 Million Reais
summary: Companhia Brasileira de Alumínio (CBA) reported a record quarterly net profit of R$616 million, a 366% increase, with net revenue reaching R$2.7 billion.
why: CBA is a major aluminum producer; its earnings are highly sensitive to global aluminum prices and industrial demand.

impacts.name: CBA
impacts.why: Record profits and revenue growth are strong positive signals for the company's equity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The significant profit growth, driven by strong operational performance, typically leads to upward price pressure on the stock.
